node.title: FPC5 shifted-Johnson GRS shell cap
node.closure: theorem composition plus independent exact official-row replay
node.statement: For one FPC5 source/touched/degree cell, let H=t ell and W=1 when u<0, while H=d+ell and W=binom(b,u) when 0<=u<=b; put K=N-H and a=N-d. For m>=3 define Q_m=floor sqrt((2m+1)^14 N^7/(384^2(K-1)^3)). If K>=2, (2ma)^2>=(2m+1)^2N(K-1), and KQ_m<q-N, then the complete fixed cell has at most W ceil(Q_m(q-N)/(q-N-KQ_m)) contributors. The exact background factor is retained. Smallest-row replay newly caps one first-scale cell at rates 1/2, 1/4, 1/8 and six shifted/nonpositive-Johnson cells in the rate-1/16 M=61 slice on explicit upper field slices; no source/profile aggregation is claimed.
